summary: A KML or KMZ card in a batch is no longer refused with the inspection route's words. Publishing it queues
SH2's fenced intake-native-derivative job; convert-native reads the original from object storage onto
scratch disk (hash and size checked) and streams it through Expat (a document type or entity declaration
is refused). Each Document or Folder holding Placemarks becomes one GeoJSON derivative with SH2's locator
sidecar (the whole file is one layer when it has neither); only the open Placemark is held. Each kept
derivative is a large-original-v1 child with SH2's lineage, enrolled, and the large GeoJSON path reads it

D1: A KMZ is read from its root doc.kml, else from its only .kml member, as a stream under the shapefile
ZIP's member checks (no unsafe path, link or encrypted member), never past the member's stated size,
128 MiB or a 1:100 expansion; with several .kml members and no root doc.kml it is not converted, in
words. Placemark name, ExtendedData Data/value and SchemaData/SimpleData become properties as written
(strings); styles, descriptions and styleUrl are not kept. A repeated or unnamed property refuses
that Placemark (sidecar names it). A layer is named by its container's name, else 'Folder n' or
'Document n'; a repeated name gets ' (2)'. Position is the Placemark's sequence in the file.
D1_crs: Each layer is EPSG:4326 with crsSource 'stated' (the existing file-stated value; no separate
'file_stated' value was added) and crsBasis 'the KML 2.2 specification states longitude and latitude
on WGS 84 (EPSG:4326)', kept in the converted layer, the sidecar header and the child's lineage; the
D2: A coordinate's third value is written as the GeoJSON position's third number, as written, never
measured or filled; a Placemark mixing 2- and 3-value tuples is not written (coordinates_mixed_height).
altitudeMode (KML or gx) is kept as written in the property altitudeMode.
D3: NetworkLink, GroundOverlay, PhotoOverlay and ScreenOverlay are counted, never fetched or read; the
conversion's notRead counts become 'Kept in the original but not fetched or read: NetworkLink (n)'.
A Placemark whose geometry is Model or gx:Track/MultiTrack is not written (geometry_not_read:<kind>).
A layer with no Placemark whose geometry could be written is not converted; a file with none rests
not_understood in words. A root other than kml in a KML 2.2 namespace is not converted, in words.
decisions.D4: SH2's bounds apply unchanged (128 MiB original, 128 MiB per derivative, 100 layers).
